api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Osnap Priority And One Shot Overrides” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M02: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Osnap Priority And One Shot Overrides”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

windows_four_view_one_shot_2026_11_18.scope: With the master off, desktop clicks started a Line in Perspective and accepted an exact elevated End in Side View after a miss. A second Line started in Looking Down and accepted an exact elevated Mid in Through Finger. Each command consumed its one-shot and produced one Undo entry. Human M02-UI review remains open.

runtime_implementation.scope: SnapKind has a deterministic priority; SnapState filters a one-shot kind for one query, accept clears it, and cancel also consumes it.
remaining: Manual M02-UI review pending; no human sign-off is claimed.

standalone_verification_2026_10_22.acceptance: A one-shot MID beats persistent END for one pick, then END returns; Escape consumes the override without leaking it.

standalone_verification_2026_11_18.scope: In a Looking Down Line point prompt with master off, a deferred End miss leaves the one-shot armed and keyboard focus in the viewport. Escape clears the override and leaves the Line active. E re-arms and a sphere-pole retry commits the exact preview point.

between_icon_prompt_2026_11_18.scope: After the first Line viewport pick, the Between icon focuses the reference prompt. The fixture types the first reference, cancels Between with Escape, and completes the original Line by mouse with one Undo entry.

between_addon_preview_2026_11_19.scope: Between discards the old Polyline hover segment. The packaged add-on sees the midpoint of two End references in its preview and accepted point. The outer command commits one segment with one Undo.

between_completion_shortcut_2026_11_18.scope: The repaired sequence gives focus to the Between reference prompt, commits the midpoint in one Undo entry, then arms End one-shot with an empty draft. Windows replay on the patched binary showed the End badge and Escape cancellation. The archive readback confirmed exactly one Line with the expected midpoint.

one_shot_miss_status_2026_11_18.scope: The immediate Mid and deferred End paths report the active kind when a click misses. No geometry reaches Line on a miss and Escape clears only the override. The End retry accepts the exact source pole in one Undo entry.

escape_release_one_shot_2026_11_19.scope: The viewport recovers an unpaired physical Escape release to clear End while idle or during Line. Windows trace and model readback verify that Line keeps its prompt and accepts its endpoint in one Undo entry.
